column1: # Oracle-vs-oracle disagreements for Armenian, ruled on so the golden
# harness can report them as resolved. o1 is the uniparser grammar
#   variant = both forms are standard (register, archaism, doublet)
#   o1 / o2 = that oracle is right, the other is a data error
# The ruling also drives the engine: scripts/hye/mine_verbs.py reads
# this file, so a slot ruled o1/o2 is mined from that oracle into
# data/hye/verbs.tsv instead of being left to the rule.
